status_reasons: every required action is backed by an applicable approved instruction

detail.text: Look up the code and follow the guide's action for GR-204; do not override the error with a manual posting.
GR-204 means the scanned quantity is higher than the open quantity of the purchase order line, i.e. the delivery is above what is still open on the line.
Post only the open quantity, and only after the shift lead has confirmed the count.
Move the excess units to the over-delivery area OD-01 and inform purchasing.
Do not increase the purchase order quantity yourself.
Do not work around the error by posting against a different purchase order line.
Purchasing is the responsible role for over-deliveries, with a same-working-day response time; inform them of the excess units.
The shift lead confirms the count before posting; the matrix lists recounts under the shift lead (30 minutes).
